design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and change only the registered completed-benefit state within each pair.

Downstream prompts are standalone help-allocation episodes with new actors and events. Match status, likability, familiarity, and neutral contact; include exactly one response contract and no probe suffix.
Do not ask the model to label reciprocity or append any instruction after the response contract.

probe_train.instructions: Generate complete matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep contact, request, actors, and wording identical within a pair except the registered completed-benefit clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Change only the registered completed-benefit clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new domains. Change only the registered completed-benefit clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone help-allocation items with assigned metadata. Use new actors and events, and include exactly one two-integer response contract without naming reciprocity.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a distinct standalone help-allocation pool with the same metadata schedule. Use new actors and events and exactly one response contract.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone help-allocation items for calibration. Keep the neutral contact design and include exactly one response contract.
